title: Good Experience but Felt Short
text: Well organized trip with friendly guides/drivers. The 1-day Gilbraltar tour was entertaining. 2 hour drive from Malaga to Gilbraltar border. Quick border crossing and the bus tour began. We stopped at St. Michael's cave for 40 minutes or so. When you get to the auditorium inside the cave you are only a couple of minutes away from the bus, so feel free to relax and enjoy the light show a little longer. There is a souvenir shop as yiu exit the cave. You might want to grab something in case there's no time afterwards. We also stopped at a point or two with great views along the way for 10 minutes
author: corderoom
